name: Searn Firewarder
summary: In Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder guides Horde shamans toward the elements.

sections.title: A Guide to the Elements
sections.body: Inside Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder guides shamans seeking the elements. Many Darkspear trolls commune with spirits through witch doctors and voodoo rituals. Searn guides initiates toward distant mentors and rites for the Call of Fire, Call of Water, and Call of Air, which teach them to commune with the elemental spirits of fire, water, and air. He stands among the Horde's high command in Orgrimmar.

faq.answer: Searn Firewarder trains jungle troll shamans inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. He guides developing shamans across the Horde through their spiritual journeys.

faq.q: What quests does Searn Firewarder offer?
faq.answer: Searn guides shamans through the Call of Fire, Call of Water, and Call of Air, pointing them toward distant shrines and spiritual teachers across the continents.

faq.q: Why is a troll shaman stationed inside Grommash Hold?
aliases: why is searn in grommash hold
faq.answer: Grommash Hold is the heart of Orgrimmar's leadership, where Warchief Thrall and prominent representatives of the allied races gather. Searn's presence reflects the close unity between the orcs and the Darkspear tribe, and shamanism's central place in the new Horde.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can look to Searn for guidance toward the masters and trials needed to bind the elements to your totem.
As a Darkspear troll, you can see in Searn how your spiritual traditions stand alongside those of your orc and tauren allies.
